title: A theme-named block on another theme renders styled in that theme: the Network island becomes a contract skin for every family

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail:
Generalise NETWORK_BLOCK_CSS. Foreign-theme coverage for every family at or above 0.9 in the audit (was 0.04 to 0.25). Published sites change only where a block was already unstyled; no styled block moves.

Shipped components/sites/contract-skin-css.ts: each theme-named family's block rules re-scoped to a data-skin-family wrapper the renderer sets, with its colors and faces read from the host theme. Sent by site-page.tsx for the families a page carries. Pinned in contract-skin-css.test.ts. Renders checked at 390 and 1280 on light and dark hosts.
